items.docs: Initiates a Unify (Unified Authentication) flow that passively recognizes a returning customer by phone possession and an optional bound Prove Key, returning a correlation ID and the set of allowed next calls.

info.name: Bind a Prove Key to a Unify session

items.docs: Binds a Prove Key to the phone number of a Unify session and returns the possession result so the customer can be passively recognized on future visits.

info.name: Get Unify session status and trust result

items.docs: Checks the status of a Unify session and returns the possession and trust evaluation used to make a risk-aware authentication decision.
